component.name: DK Tracker
component.summary: A Kimai client with a calendar, summaries and a tray timer
Klient Kimai z kalendarzem, podsumowaniami i timerem w tacce

description.p: Keep track of your working time in Kimai from a native desktop app instead of a browser tab. The main window shows your entries week by week, sums up any period and lays the entries out in a calendar you can edit with the mouse.
Czas pracy w Kimai w natywnej aplikacji zamiast karty w przeglądarce. Okno główne pokazuje wpisy tydzień po tygodniu, podsumowuje dowolny okres i układa wpisy w kalendarzu, który poprawia się myszą.

ul.li: Entries by week and day: start a timer or add time by hand, edit every option the server has, delete with undo
Wpisy tygodniami i dniami: timer albo czas wpisany ręcznie, edycja każdej opcji z serwera, usuwanie z cofnięciem
Summaries: billable time, the average per working day against a daily norm, a bar chart and a breakdown by project, customer or activity
Podsumowania: czas płatny, średnia na dzień roboczy wobec normy, wykres słupkowy i podział wg projektu, klienta lub rodzaju pracy
A calendar: drag to add an entry, move it to another hour or day, change its length
Kalendarz: nowy wpis przeciągnięciem, przesuwanie na inną godzinę lub dzień, zmiana długości
A tray icon showing how long the timer runs, with a quick window to start and stop
Ikona w tacce z czasem trwającego wpisu i okienkiem do szybkiego startu i stopu
Reminders about long timers and a lost connection; the API token stays in the system wallet
Przypomnienia o długim timerze i utracie połączenia; token API zostaje w portfelu systemu

description.p: The calendar counts seconds: an entry stopped and the next one started within the same minute both show, one under the other, and an entry shorter than a minute gets its own block beside the next one.

Delivers the changes of 0.10.9, which did not reach the update repository: in the window by the tray icon, the start and end times sit on one line and are chosen from a list; clickable elements show a hand cursor.

In the window by the tray icon, the start and end times of the running entry sit on one line and are chosen from a list of hours and minutes, as in the main window, instead of being typed. Everything clickable shows a hand cursor.
Fixes a crash on clicking the tray icon when the window by the tray had been made smaller than its content needs: the window now keeps at least the height of its content.
With more than one monitor, the window by the tray icon now opens on the monitor where the icon was clicked, sized to fit it, instead of always on the primary one (KDE Plasma).

A new description and screenshots: DK Tracker is shown as the Kimai client it has become — the main window with entries, summaries and the calendar — with the tray icon for a quick start and stop. The About page and the app's help say the same.

A calendar in the main window: a day or a week (five or seven days) of hours with the entries as blocks in project colours. Drag on an empty spot to add an entry, drag a block to move it (also to another day) or its edge to change the hour; it snaps to quarter hours, Alt for the exact minute. A click opens a bubble to edit, delete or resume the entry.
The settings page ends with "About": the version, the licence and a link to the project page.

Summaries in the main window: a week, month, year or any range of days with the total and billable time, the average per working day against a daily norm (set in the settings), a bar chart of days or months in project colours and a breakdown by project, customer or activity. Hovering a bar, a slice or a row lists the entries it holds.
The main window opens on the entries again; it stayed on the settings when the token came from the wallet a moment after the window.
Tags are chosen from the list Kimai has; the edit window shows no rates (as Kimai's own form for accounts that may not change them); a stored token shows as a mask; lists show a scroll bar.

A main window: your entries by week and day, an edit window with every option of an entry (hours, project, description in several lines, tags, rates, custom fields), entries added by hand, deleted with undo, and the settings as a page of the window. The app opens this window from the menu; the tray icon is optional, and the theme can be light, dark or as the system's.
The description field in the quick window grows with every line, so the first line no longer scrolls out of sight.
The window next to the tray is low again while the app is not configured.

New name DK Tracker with its own DK icon, a readable mark in the window header, GPL-3.0-or-later licence, and a new app id (reinstall from the new repository). Resizing the window next to the tray follows the pointer smoothly at any size.

New name WS Tracker and its own icon (no longer the Kimai logo). Search all your Kimai entries, long descriptions unfold on click, the running entry's project and activity can change, and the form suggests the project and activity of your newest entry.
First beta: tray icon, quick window, settings, notifications and autostart.
